name: Mean
plain: Add them all up, then divide by how many there are.

name: Standard deviation
plain: The typical distance from the mean.

name: z-score
plain: How many standard deviations a value is from average.

name: Regression line
f: ŷ = a + bx,  b = r · (s_y ÷ s_x)
plain: Predict y from x. The slope uses r and both spreads.

name: "Or" rule
f: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A and B)
plain: Add the chances, then take away the overlap you counted twice.

name: Conditional probability
f: P(A | B) = P(A and B) ÷ P(B)
plain: Zoom in on just the times B happened.

name: Expected value
plain: Each value times its chance, all added up.

name: Binomial
f: P(X = k) = C(n, k) · pᵏ · (1 − p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ;  mean np, SD √(np(1 − p))
plain: The chance of exactly k successes in n tries.

name: Standard error of p̂
plain: How much a sample percent usually wobbles.

name: Standard error of x̄
plain: How much a sample mean usually wobbles.

name: Confidence interval
plain: Your best guess, plus or minus a margin of error.

name: Test statistic
plain: How many standard errors your result is from what H₀ predicts.

name: Expected count
plain: The count you'd expect in a two-way table cell if the two variables weren't linked.

name: Chi-square
plain: Adds up how far each observed count is from the expected one.
